scope: Block asset library, whole-body/whole-ring dictionary, seeded small-planet assembly and native inspection. User authorized generation on 2026-10-15. Historical canopy matching remains failed and stopped.
verdict: Implemented component selection and inspected native previews; no accepted screenshot match. Manual mouse use remains untested.

P01.reason: Eleven complete components: four bodies and seven rings. Generated planets reference component identities; block assets remain separate.

P02.reason: Literal pane geometry retained. One-row surround is 2.125x1x2.125 blocks; two-row is 2.125x2x2.125; upright frame is 2.125x3x.125. Compared fixed-scale height and attachment views.

P03.reason: All 160 pane states remain inspectable. Generated individual view labels actual mesh bounds; connection masks are resolved after body-material choice.

P04.reason: Full glass retained for earlier/larger examples. Native alpha/depth checks and reverse-submission pixel equality pass, including generated two-row rings.

P05.reason: Emission class, body material and pane colour have distinct random channels. Material emission is used literally; an emission-class change can change attachment arms through the chosen block. No emission inferred from colour.

P06.reason: Small rings now have one colour, following the user correction. Earlier fixed-cell mixed/full-glass comparison remains available; it is not the small generator palette.

P07.reason: Local 1.19.3 textures and actual dimensions retained beside a unit reference. Three gallery seeds include lit and unlit materials; static texture limitation retained.

P08.reason: 61 hidden frames exercise every gallery mode, angle comparisons, material/night/neutral views and individual results. Human mouse interaction remains untested.

P09.reason: User plot, control and accepted light-formula hashes match the starting values. Existing experiments remain; gallery choices are local state.

P10.reason: README reports local asset version and limitations. This is component selection, not a screenshot or canopy match; historical canopy failure remains stopped.

P11.reason: Each result has one whole body plus zero or one whole ring. Body/ring cell arrangements persist; 9-18 blocks can still mean two parts.

P12.reason: Twenty geometric body/ring pairs are valid in the complete dictionary; small-generation allowed pairs are a separate whitelist. Overlap/duplicate rejection and body-dependent pane arms pass.

P13.reason: Earlier authored examples and fixed-cell colour comparison remain preserved. Generation follows that inspected stage. Current controlled height/attachment comparisons keep angle and scale equal.

P14.reason: Same-material full-glass interior culling retained. Equal-depth transparent faces now use geometry/material tie-breaking, fixing a one-channel-level order difference. Arbitrary intersecting transparency remains unsupported.

P15.reason: All 12000 sampled assemblies use a single pane colour and exclude full glass. Earlier mixed/full-glass examples remain outside the small selection rules.

P16.reason: Two-high ring contains 16 literal upright panes. Controlled comparison changes only the second row of eight panes around the same two-block shroomlight body.

P17.reason: Indexed seed choices preserve results under count/evaluation order changes. Chance 0 and 1, compatible pairs, emission class and independent choice channels pass across 12000 selections. Frame60 extends frame40 without changing its first nine choices.

P18.reason: Generated grid identifies body/ring/material/colour/emission and opens the exact indexed choice. Individual captures retain dimensions and both counts. Compact labels resolve 12-item overlap at tested 1280x800; manual clicks remain untested.

P19.reason: Explicit attachment metadata rejects honey, jack-o-lantern and pumpkin. Local client bytecode confirms pumpkin exceptions and honey inset collision shape; controlled top view shows gaps without inward arms, preserving connected corners.

P20.reason: Every planet exhibit has an independent light group. GPU test confirms another exhibit cannot brighten its receiver. Existing formula remains; shadows, occlusion and bloom remain absent.

new_findings: Body material affects pane connection arms even when both bodies have full cube render bounds.
Two-row rings remain upright walls rather than a horizontal disc.
Gallery neighbour emissions must be isolated when comparing luminosity.
Six-line labels overlap in a12-item grid at1280x800; compact grid labels and detailed individual inspection fix the tested layout.
